decks.notes: This Dimir Control deck focuses on disruption and card advantage to control the game. With counterspells like Negate and Sinister Sabotage, removal spells like Fatal Push and Soul Shatter, and card draw engines like Memory Deluge and Thought Distortion, the deck aims to outlast opponents and win the long game. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Hullbreaker Horror and Torrential Gearhulk provide a strong win condition, while Shark Typhoon can create threats at instant speed. The land base is designed to support both color requirements and utility lands for additional control options.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on efficient creature removal and hand disruption to control the game early on. With powerful threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, the deck aims to pressure opponents quickly while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Dreadbore. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides additional reach and flexibility in closing out games. Overall, the deck seeks to maintain a proactive game plan while disrupting opponents to secure victory in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive spirit creatures with evasion abilities to quickly chip away at opponents' life totals. By using cards like Curious Obsession to draw extra cards and Geistlight Snare to counter opponent's spells, the deck aims to maintain pressure while disrupting opponent's game plan. The inclusion of a snow-covered island allows for the activation of Faceless Haven, providing an additional threat that can be difficult for opponents to deal with. Overall, the deck seeks to overwhelm opponents with a fast-paced tempo strategy while using spirits' abilities to gain incremental advantages.

This aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with quick and efficient creature damage, boosted by powerful spells and abilities. Utilizing creatures like Anax, Kari Zev, and Bonecrusher Giant, along with burn spells like Play with Fire and Kumano Faces Kakkazan, the deck seeks to deal damage swiftly and decisively. Torbran, Thane of Red Fell enhances all red sources of damage, while cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel punish opponents for playing spells. With a mix of creature pressure and direct damage, this Red Deck Wins archetype is designed to win games through aggressive tactics.

The primary focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, dealing damage quickly and efficiently. The cards are all geared towards dealing damage and putting pressure on the opponent, with a heavy emphasis on cheap and efficient spells. The inclusion of powerful planeswalker Chandra adds additional threat and versatility to the deck, while lands like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide additional reach and damage potential. Overall, this deck aims to win the game as fast as possible through a combination of creature attacks and direct damage spells.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly play and buff spirit creatures to overwhelm the opponent with high-powered attacks. By utilizing cards like Empyrean Eagle, Supreme Phantom, and Shacklegeist, along with evasion spells like Rattlechains and Spell Queller, the deck aims to control the board while dealing consistent damage. Curious Obsession provides card advantage and Slip Out the Back acts as removal, giving the deck the tools it needs to maintain pressure and tempo throughout the game.

This deck focuses on using green mana devotion to power up powerful green creatures and spells. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient ramping, allowing for big threats to hit the board quickly. The combination of mana dorks, payoff cards like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns, and Karn, the Great Creator's utility provides a well-rounded strategy that can adapt to different situations. Overall, the deck thrives on quickly building a wide board presence and maintaining pressure throughout the game.

The key concept of this deck is to establish board presence early with low-cost aggressive creatures like Luminarch Aspirant and Thalia's Lieutenant, while disrupting your opponent with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Dire Tactics. The deck also focuses on buffing your creatures with cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and General Kudro of Drannith to push for lethal damage quickly. With a mix of removal spells and resilient threats, this Orzhov Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and finish the game before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on controlling the board and countering key spells while slowly building card advantage with draw spells like Memory Deluge and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. With a mix of removal spells like Portable Hole and Supreme Verdict, as well as counterspells like Dovin's Veto and Absorb, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up win conditions with cards like Shark Typhoon and The Wandering Emperor. The mana base is designed to support the deck's control elements with utility lands like Castle Ardenvale and Field of Ruin.

This deck focuses on aggressively building up devotion to green to maximize the mana production from Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. By quickly ramping up with mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, and playing powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with threats early on. Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provide additional utility and card advantage, while cards like Oath of Nissa and Wolfwillow Haven help fix mana and ramp up quickly. The key concept is to quickly establish a board presence and utilize powerful green devotion synergies to overwhelm opponents.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix while controlling the board with removal spells like Lightning Axe and Strangle. It uses card draw and selection spells like Opt and Chart a Course to dig for the necessary combo pieces while using Thing in the Ice as another threat. The inclusion of Temporal Trespass and Treasure Cruise allows for powerful late-game plays to close out the game if the aggressive early game plan doesn't succeed. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while maximizing consistency.

The main focus of this deck is to play aggressively with a mix of tempo control and Spirit creature synergy. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with quick, evasive creatures like Ascendant Spirit, Supreme Phantom, and Shacklegeist while utilizing cards like Brazen Borrower and Rattlechains to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Curious Obsession provides card advantage, while Geistlight Snare and Spell Pierce offer control elements. The inclusion of Snow-Covered Island and Faceless Haven ensures mana consistency and a solid land base. With a combination of speed and disruption, this deck aims to assert dominance in the early game.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with efficient removal and disruption to control the game. It combines aggressive threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester with powerful disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also includes ways to generate card advantage and grind out games with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. With a mix of burn, hand disruption, and powerful threats, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and maintain pressure throughout the game.

This aggressive red deck aims to quickly deal damage to the opponent's life total using efficient creatures and burn spells. It focuses on playing cheap spells and creatures to apply pressure early in the game, while also utilizing cards like Chandra, Dressed to Kill and Kumano Faces Kakkazan for additional damage and control. The deck also includes utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins to maintain aggressive board presence. It aims to close out games before the opponent can stabilize or gain too much life.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to cast powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provide additional utility and card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats and use cards like Nissa, Who Shakes the World and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to further enhance the board presence. Overall, the key strategy is to establish strong board presence and dominate the game with green devotion.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value, utilizing cards like Cauldron Familiar, Witch's Oven, and Korvold, Fae-Cursed King. It aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Assassin's Trophy, along with card advantage engines such as Trail of Crumbs and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The overall strategy is to establish a solid board presence, generate incremental advantage through sacrificing and card draw, and ultimately outvalue the opponent to secure the win.
